hooks.name: Report lint
hooks.description: After a report in reports/ is saved, check it against the house rule before a human reads it.

action.prompt: A report in reports/ was just saved. Before a human reads it, check it against the house rule: (1) the 'Backed by evidence' section lists only items labeled verified; (2) every listed item has a receipt line with an id, a label, sources, a fingerprint, and a checked-at time; (3) no needs-evidence or likely-false-positive item appears in 'Backed by evidence'; (4) the summary counts match the items actually listed in each section. If everything holds, reply with a one-line PASS. Otherwise list each problem with the item id and what to fix. Keep the wording plain.
